hook: Some of the richest people in America pay a lower tax rate than a nurse or a teacher, and most of the time it's completely legal. In this video I explain how, from three angles: the numbers (capital gains, untaxed growth, buy borrow die, the step up in basis), the psychology of how the wealthy think about taxes, and the legal moves ordinary workers can use this year. Education only, not tax advice.
tags: how the rich pay less tax
